entry.title: Representation Learning to Study Temporal Dynamics in Tutorial Scaffolding

author.name: Conrad Borchers, Jiayi Zhang, Ashish Gurung

entry.summary: Introduces an embedding-based approach to analyze scaffolding dynamics in tutoring dialogue by computing cosine similarity between turns, problem statements, and solutions. Applied to 1,576 real-world math tutoring dialogues, revealing systematic differences in task alignment.

entry.title: EnvSocial-Diff: A Diffusion-Based Crowd Simulation Model with Environmental Conditioning and Individual-Group Interaction

author.name: Bingxue Zhao, Qi Zhang, Hui Huang

entry.summary: Proposes EnvSocial-Diff, a diffusion-based crowd simulation model that incorporates environmental conditioning (obstacles, lighting, objects of interest) and individual-group interaction dynamics for realistic pedestrian trajectory modeling.

entry.title: CAKE: Real-time Action Detection via Motion Distillation and Background-aware Contrastive Learning

author.name: Hieu Hoang, Dung Trung Tran, Hong Nguyen, Nam-Phong Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes CAKE for online action detection that uses flow-based distillation to transfer motion knowledge into RGB models without computing optical flow at inference, with a Dynamic Motion Adapter and contrastive learning.

entry.title: SemLayer: Semantic-aware Generative Segmentation and Layer Construction for Abstract Icons

author.name: Haiyang Xu, Ronghuan Wu, Li-Yi Wei, Nanxuan Zhao, Chenxi Liu, Cuong Nguyen, Zhuowen Tu, Zhaowen Wang

entry.summary: Introduces SemLayer, a pipeline for restoring semantic layer structure from flattened vector icons using generative models for chromatic differentiation and semantic completion of occluded regions.

entry.title: PosterIQ: A Design Perspective Benchmark for Poster Understanding and Generation

author.name: Yuheng Feng, Wen Zhang, Haodong Duan, Xingxing Zou

entry.summary: Presents PosterIQ, a design-driven benchmark for poster understanding and generation covering composition, typography, and semantic intent, revealing gaps in current MLLMs and diffusion generators.

entry.title: InstanceRSR: Real-World Super-Resolution via Instance-Aware Representation Alignment

author.name: Zixin Guo, Kai Zhao, Luyan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes InstanceRSR for real-world super-resolution that introduces instance-level feature alignment alongside global consistency, using semantic information to recover fine-grained object details.

entry.title: Teacher-Student Diffusion Model for Text-Driven 3D Hand Motion Generation

author.name: Ching-Lam Cheng, Bin Zhu, Shengfeng He

entry.summary: Proposes TSHaMo, a teacher-student diffusion framework for text-driven 3D hand motion generation where the teacher uses auxiliary MANO parameters to guide the student, which operates from text alone at inference time.

entry.title: Bio-Inspired Event-Based Visual Servoing for Ground Robots

author.name: Maral Mordad, Kian Behzad, Debojyoti Biswas, Noah J. Cowan, Milad Siami

entry.summary: Presents a bio-inspired event-based visual servoing framework using Dynamic Vision Sensors for ground robots, showing that spatial kernels applied to asynchronous event streams can analytically isolate specific kinematic states.

entry.title: A Longitudinal Analysis of the CEC Single-Objective Competitions (2010-2024) and Implications for Variational Quantum Optimization

author.name: Vojt\v{e}ch Nov\'ak, Tom\'a\v{s} Bezd\v{e}k, Ivan Zelinka, Swagatam Das, Martin Beseda

entry.summary: Provides a historical analysis of IEEE CEC single-objective optimization competitions (2010-2024), identifying how benchmark design choices shaped winning algorithms and connecting findings to variational quantum optimization.

entry.title: Task-Space Singularity Avoidance for Control Affine Systems Using Control Barrier Functions

author.name: Kimia Forghani, Suraj Raval, Lamar Mair, Axel Krieger, Yancy Diaz-Mercado

entry.summary: Presents a control barrier function framework for singularity avoidance in control-affine systems, constructing barrier functions based on eigenvalues of the input-output mapping to maintain safety from rank-deficient configurations.

entry.title: Bidirectionality is the Obvious BCI Paradigm

author.name: Elliot Callender

entry.summary: Proposes bidirectional brain-computer interfaces that read and write native neural representations, arguing that current BCI research is missing the obvious step of training models to communicate in 'neuralese' back to the brain.

entry.title: Identification of NMF by choosing maximum-volume basis vectors

author.name: Qianqian Qi, Zhongming Chen, Peter G. M. van der Heijden

entry.summary: Proposes maximum-volume-constrained NMF as an alternative to minimum-volume NMF, making basis vectors as distinct as possible rather than similar, with identifiability guarantees for highly mixed data.

entry.title: Comparative analysis of dual-form networks for live land monitoring using multi-modal satellite image time series

author.name: Iris Dumeur (CB), J\'er\'emy Anger (CB), Gabriele Facciolo (CB)

entry.summary: Compares dual-form attention mechanisms (linear attention and retention) for efficient multi-modal satellite image time series analysis, enabling parallel training with recurrent inference for incremental land monitoring.

entry.title: Boost Like a (Var)Pro: Trust-Region Gradient Boosting via Variable Projection

author.name: Abhijit Chowdhary, Elizabeth Newman, Deepanshu Verma

entry.summary: Introduces VPBoost, a gradient boosting algorithm for separable smooth approximators that fuses variable projection (enforcing linear weight optimality) with trust-region optimization for the nonlinear parameters.

entry.title: KCLNet: Electrically Equivalence-Oriented Graph Representation Learning for Analog Circuits

author.name: Peng Xu, Yapeng Li, Tinghuan Chen, Tsung-Yi Ho, Bei Yu

entry.summary: Presents KCLNet, a graph representation learning framework for analog circuits inspired by Kirchhoff's Current Law, using asynchronous GNN message passing and electrically-simulated representations.

entry.title: Language-Assisted Image Clustering Guided by Discriminative Relational Signals and Adaptive Semantic Centers

author.name: Jun Ma, Xu Zhang, Zhengxing Jiao, Yaxin Hou, Hui Liu, Junhui Hou, Yuheng Jia

entry.summary: Proposes a language-assisted image clustering framework using discriminative cross-modal relational signals and adaptive semantic centers to improve cluster separability beyond naive text-image alignment.

entry.title: Wafer-Level Etch Spatial Profiling for Process Monitoring from Time-Series with Time-LLM

author.name: Hyunwoo Kim, Munyoung Lee, Seung Hyub Jeon, Kyu Sung Lee

entry.summary: Applies Time-LLM for wafer-level etch spatial profiling by extending LLM reprogramming from time-series forecasting to spatial estimation in semiconductor manufacturing process monitoring.

entry.title: Robust Multilingual Text-to-Pictogram Mapping for Scalable Reading Rehabilitation

author.name: Soufiane Jhilal, Martina Galletti

entry.summary: A multilingual AI-powered system that enhances text with pictograms for children with Special Educational Needs. Evaluated across five languages (English, French, Italian, Spanish, Arabic) through expert clinical review and latency assessment.

entry.title: HAM: A Training-Free Style Transfer Approach via Heterogeneous Attention Modulation for Diffusion Models

author.name: Yeqi He, Liang Li, Zhiwen Yang, Xichun Sheng, Zhidong Zhao, Chenggang Yan

entry.summary: Proposes HAM, a training-free style transfer approach using heterogeneous attention modulation in diffusion models to better balance style reference transfer and content identity preservation.

entry.title: Retinal Layer Segmentation in OCT Images With 2.5D Cross-slice Feature Fusion Module for Glaucoma Assessment

author.name: Hyunwoo Kim, Heesuk Kim, Wungrak Choi, Jae-Sang Hyun

entry.summary: Proposes a 2.5D OCT retinal layer segmentation framework with a cross-slice feature fusion module that balances 2D efficiency with 3D contextual information for glaucoma assessment.

entry.title: AMIF: Authorizable Medical Image Fusion Model with Built-in Authentication

author.name: Jie Song, Jun Jia, Wei Sun, Wangqiu Zhou, Tao Tan, Guangtao Zhai

entry.summary: Introduces AMIF, an authorizable medical image fusion model with built-in authentication for IP protection, combining multimodal fusion with watermarking for ownership verification.

entry.title: Positive-First Most Ambiguous: A Simple Active Learning Criterion for Interactive Retrieval of Rare Categories

author.name: Kawtar Zaher, Olivier Buisson, Alexis Joly

entry.summary: Proposes a simple active learning criterion ('Positive-First Most Ambiguous') for interactive retrieval of rare categories in highly imbalanced settings, targeting biodiversity monitoring and ecological applications.

entry.title: Learning What Can Be Picked: Active Reachability Estimation for Efficient Robotic Fruit Harvesting

author.name: Nur Afsa Syeda, Mohamed Elmahallawy, Luis Fernando de la Torre, John Miller

entry.summary: Combines RGB-D perception with active learning to learn fruit reachability as a binary decision problem for robotic harvesting, reducing unnecessary inverse kinematics computation in orchard environments.

entry.title: Adaptive Gaussian Process Search for Simulation-Based Sample Size Estimation in Clinical Prediction Models: Validation of the pmsims R Package

author.name: Oyebayo Ridwan Olaniran, Diana Shamsutdinova, Sarah Markham, Felix Zimmer, Daniel Stahl, Gordon Forbes, Ewan Carr

entry.summary: Presents and validates pmsims, an R package using Gaussian process surrogate modeling for simulation-based sample size determination in clinical prediction models, offering a flexible alternative to analytical approaches.

entry.title: Where Experts Disagree, Models Fail: Detecting Implicit Legal Citations in French Court Decisions

author.name: Avrile Floro (UPHF), Tamara Dhorasoo (UPHF), Soline Pellez (UPHF), Nils Holzenberger

entry.summary: Studies implicit legal citation detection in French court decisions, finding that expert disagreement (κ=0.33) predicts model failures. Introduces a benchmark of 1,015 annotated passage-article pairs and achieves F1=0.70.

entry.title: CN-Buzz2Portfolio: A Chinese-Market Dataset and Benchmark for LLM-Based Macro and Sector Asset Allocation from Daily Trending Financial News

author.name: Liyuan Chen, Shilong Li, Jiangpeng Yan, Shuoling Liu, Qiang Yang, Xiu Li

entry.summary: Introduces CN-Buzz2Portfolio, a benchmark mapping daily trending Chinese financial news to macro and sector asset allocation, addressing the gap between LLM-as-agent evaluation and reproducible financial benchmarking.

entry.title: YOLOv10 with Kolmogorov-Arnold networks and vision-language foundation models for interpretable object detection and trustworthy multimodal AI in computer vision perception

author.name: Marios Impraimakis, Daniel Vazquez, Feiyu Zhou

entry.summary: Uses Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks as interpretable post-hoc surrogates to model trustworthiness of YOLOv10 detections, enabling transparent visualization of feature influences on detection confidence.

entry.title: Leveraging LLMs and Social Media to Understand User Perception of Smartphone-Based Earthquake Early Warnings

author.name: Hanjing Wang, S. Mostafa Mousavi, Patrick Robertson, Richard M. Allen, Alexie Barski, Robert Bosch, Nivetha Thiruverahan, Youngmin Cho, Tajinder Gadh, Steve Malkos, Boone Spooner, Greg Wimpey, Marc Stogaitis

entry.summary: Uses LLMs to analyze 500+ social media posts about Android's earthquake early warning system during a 2025 Turkey earthquake, extracting 42 attributes related to user experience and behavior.

entry.title: Residual Attention Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Robust Multiphysics Simulation of Steady-State Electrothermal Energy Systems

author.name: Yuqing Zhou, Ze Tao, Fujun Liu

entry.summary: Proposes RA-PINN, a residual attention physics-informed neural network for coupled electrothermal multiphysics simulation, solving velocity, pressure, electric-potential, and temperature fields simultaneously.

entry.title: AI Generalisation Gap In Comorbid Sleep Disorder Staging

author.name: Saswata Bose, Suvadeep Maiti, Shivam Kumar Sharma, Mythirayee S, Tapabrata Chakraborti, Srijitesh Rajendran, Raju S. Bapi

entry.summary: Demonstrates that deep learning sleep staging models trained on healthy subjects generalize poorly to clinical populations with comorbid conditions like ischemic stroke. Introduces iSLEEPS, a new clinically-annotated stroke dataset, and uses Grad-CAM to systematically reveal the generalization gap.

entry.title: The Luna Bound Propagator for Formal Analysis of Neural Networks

author.name: Henry LeCates, Haoze Wu

entry.summary: Introduces Luna, a C++ implementation of alpha-CROWN bound propagation for neural network verification, competitive with the Python state-of-the-art on VNN-COMP 2025 benchmarks.

entry.title: Reservoir-Based Graph Convolutional Networks

author.name: Mayssa Soussia, Gita Ayu Salsabila, Mohamed Ali Mahjoub, Islem Rekik

entry.summary: Proposes integrating reservoir computing into GCNs to handle long-range dependencies and dynamic data without deep stacking, avoiding over-smoothing while maintaining stable information propagation.

entry.title: Towards Safe Learning-Based Non-Linear Model Predictive Control through Recurrent Neural Network Modeling

author.name: Mihaela-Larisa Clement, M\'onika Farsang, Agnes Poks, Johannes Edelmann, Manfred Pl\"ochl, Radu Grosu, Ezio Bartocci

entry.summary: Proposes Sequential-AMPC for learning-based nonlinear MPC approximation with shared parameters across prediction horizon, wrapped with safety-augmented fallback mechanisms for safe deployment.

entry.title: Digital Twin-Assisted Measurement Design and Channel Statistics Prediction

author.name: Robin J. Williams, Mahmoud Saad Abouamer, Petar Popovski

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid wireless channel prediction framework combining uncalibrated digital twins with Gaussian process models to leverage environmental geometry without costly DT calibration.

entry.title: A visual observation on the geometry of UMAP projections of the difference vectors of antonym and synonym word pair embeddings

author.name: Rami Luisto

entry.summary: Reports a curious 'swirl' pattern appearing in UMAP projections of difference vectors between antonym word pair embeddings across multiple embedding models, contrasted with synonym pairs.

entry.title: Generating Hierarchical JSON Representations of Scientific Sentences Using LLMs

author.name: Satya Sri Rajiteswari Nimmagadda, Ethan Young, Niladri Sengupta, Ananya Jana, Aniruddha Maiti

entry.summary: Proposes using a lightweight LLM with a novel structural loss function to generate hierarchical JSON structures from scientific sentences, then tests whether these structures can preserve original meaning when reconstructed. Shows hierarchical formats effectively retain scientific text information.

entry.title: SynMVCrowd: A Large Synthetic Benchmark for Multi-view Crowd Counting and Localization

author.name: Qi Zhang, Daijie Chen, Yunfei Gong, Hui Huang

entry.summary: Proposes SynMVCrowd, a large synthetic benchmark for multi-view crowd counting and localization with 50 scenes, many camera views, and crowds up to 1,000 people, addressing overfitting issues with small existing datasets.

entry.title: A^3: Towards Advertising Aesthetic Assessment

author.name: Kaiyuan Ji, Yixuan Gao, Lu Sun, Yushuo Zheng, Zijian Chen, Jianbo Zhang, Xiangyang Zhu, Yuan Tian, Zicheng Zhang, Guangtao Zhai

entry.summary: Presents A³, a comprehensive framework for advertising aesthetic assessment with a theory-driven paradigm, dataset, MLLM, and benchmark for evaluating commercial image quality.

entry.title: Granular Ball Guided Stable Latent Domain Discovery for Domain-General Crowd Counting

author.name: Fan Chen, Shuyin Xia, Yi Wang, Xinbo Gao

entry.summary: Proposes a granular ball guided framework for stable latent domain discovery in domain-general crowd counting, using compact local clusters rather than flat clustering on noisy features.

entry.title: Powerful Teachers Matter: Text-Guided Multi-view Knowledge Distillation with Visual Prior Enhancement

author.name: Xin Zhang, Jianyang Xu, Hao Peng, Dongjing Wang, Jingyuan Zheng, Yu Li, Yuyu Yin, Hongbo Wang

entry.summary: Proposes TMKD, a knowledge distillation framework using dual-modality teachers (visual + CLIP text) with multi-view inputs and prior-aware prompts for richer supervisory signals.

entry.title: The role of spatial context and multitask learning in the detection of organic and conventional farming systems based on Sentinel-2 time series

author.name: Jan Hemmerling, Marcel Schwieder, Philippe Rufin, Leon-Friedrich Thomas, Mirela Tulbure, Patrick Hostert, Stefan Erasmi

entry.summary: Uses Vision Transformers on Sentinel-2 satellite time series to discriminate organic from conventional farming systems, examining the role of spatial context and multitask learning with crop type classification.

entry.title: Robust Distributed Cooperative Path-Following and Local Replanning for Multi-UAVs Under Differentiated Low-Altitude Paths

author.name: Zimao Sheng, Zirui Yu, Hong'an Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a cooperative control strategy for multi-UAV path following in complex low-altitude terrain with distributed coordination, wind disturbance robustness, and online obstacle avoidance replanning.

entry.title: Dynamic Fusion-Aware Graph Convolutional Neural Network for Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversations

author.name: Tao Meng, Weilun Tang, Yuntao Shou, Yilong Tan, Jun Zhou, Wei Ai, Keqin Li

entry.summary: Proposes DF-GCN, a dynamic fusion-aware graph convolutional network for multimodal emotion recognition in conversations that uses dynamic parameters for different emotion types instead of fixed fusion parameters. Addresses the limitation of existing GCN methods that balance performance across emotion categories.

entry.title: AI Mental Models: Learned Intuition and Deliberation in a Bounded Neural Architecture

author.name: Laurence Anthony

entry.summary: Tests whether a bounded neural architecture can exhibit separate intuition and deliberation pathways on a syllogistic reasoning benchmark. Proposes a dual-path architecture motivated by computational mental-model theory.

entry.title: PhySe-RPO: Physics and Semantics Guided Relative Policy Optimization for Diffusion-Based Surgical Smoke Removal

author.name: Zining Fang, Chunhui Liu, Bin Xu, Ming Chen, Xiaowei Hu, Cheng Xue

entry.summary: Proposes PhySe-RPO, a diffusion-based framework for surgical smoke removal that uses physics and semantics-guided relative policy optimization. Transforms deterministic restoration into stochastic policy with trajectory-level exploration.

entry.title: Separating Diagnosis from Control: Auditable Policy Adaptation in Agent-Based Simulations with LLM-Based Diagnostics

author.name: Shaoxin Zhong, Yuchen Su, Michael Witbrock

entry.summary: Proposes a three-layer framework separating LLM diagnosis from deterministic policy control for agent-based simulations targeting elderly loneliness. LLMs serve as diagnostic instruments while traceable rules govern policy updates.

entry.title: Minibal: Balanced Game-Playing Without Opponent Modeling

author.name: Quentin Cohen-Solal, Tristan Cazenave

entry.summary: Introduces Minibal, a Minimax variant designed for balanced play in board games, where an AI agent challenges opponents without dominating or conceding. Tested across seven board games.

entry.title: From Instructions to Assistance: a Dataset Aligning Instruction Manuals with Assembly Videos for Evaluating Multimodal LLMs

author.name: Federico Toschi, Nicol\`o Brunello, Andrea Sassella, Vincenzo Scotti, Mark James Carman

entry.summary: Creates a dataset aligning IKEA instruction manuals with assembly videos for evaluating multimodal LLMs on procedural task assistance, targeting AR/VR applications.

entry.title: Beyond the Mean: Distribution-Aware Loss Functions for Bimodal Regression

author.name: Abolfazl Mohammadi-Seif, Carlos Soares, Rita P. Ribeiro, Ricardo Baeza-Yates

entry.summary: Proposes distribution-aware loss functions for regression tasks where prediction errors follow bimodal distributions, addressing the mean-collapse problem of standard regression under coexisting confident and ambiguous predictions.

entry.title: Latent Style-based Quantum Wasserstein GAN for Drug Design

author.name: Julien Baglio, Yacine Haddad, Richard Polifka

entry.summary: Proposes a quantum Wasserstein GAN with latent style-based architecture for de novo drug design, aiming to overcome classical GAN training difficulties like mode collapse through quantum computing.

entry.title: LLM-guided headline rewriting for clickability enhancement without clickbait

author.name: Yehudit Aperstein, Linoy Halifa, Sagiv Bar, Alexander Apartsin

entry.summary: Frames clickbait not as a separate category but as extreme amplification of engagement cues, and proposes a controllable headline rewriting system that enhances clickability while preserving semantic faithfulness and editorial trust.

entry.title: UAV-DETR: DETR for Anti-Drone Target Detection

author.name: Jun Yang, Dong Wang, Hongxu Yin, Hongpeng Li, Jianxiong Yu

entry.summary: Introduces UAV-DETR for drone detection, featuring WTConv-enhanced backbone and Sliding Window Self-Attention with drastically reduced parameter overhead for detecting miniature drones against complex backgrounds.

entry.title: Avoiding Over-smoothing in Social Media Rumor Detection with Pre-trained Propagation Tree Transformer

author.name: Chaoqun Cui, Caiyan Jia

entry.summary: Proposes a Transformer-based method (P2T3) for rumor detection that avoids the over-smoothing problem inherent in GNNs when processing propagation tree structures. The key insight is that most nodes in rumor trees are 1-level nodes, causing GNN performance degradation.

entry.title: From the AI Act to a European AI Agency: Completing the Union's Regulatory Architecture

author.name: Georgios Pavlidis

entry.summary: Argues for creating a dedicated European AI Agency beyond the existing AI Office established by the EU AI Act, to enhance policy coherence, risk assessment, and international cooperation in AI governance.

entry.title: Concept-based explanations of Segmentation and Detection models in Natural Disaster Management

author.name: Samar Heydari, Jawher Said, Galip \"Umit Yolcu, Evgenii Kortukov, Elena Golimblevskaia, Evgenios Vlachos, Vasileios Mygdalis, Ioannis Pitas, Sebastian Lapuschkin, Leila Arras

entry.summary: Presents an explainability framework for flood segmentation and car detection models using PIDNet and YOLO, extending Layer-wise Relevance Propagation for sigmoid-gated fusion layers in disaster management applications.

entry.title: Targeted Adversarial Traffic Generation : Black-box Approach to Evade Intrusion Detection Systems in IoT Networks

author.name: Islam Debicha, Tayeb Kenaza, Ishak Charfi, Salah Mosbah, Mehdi Sehaki, Jean-Michel Dricot

entry.summary: Evaluates feasibility of black-box evasion attacks against IoT network intrusion detection systems, proposing both attack methods and defense strategies.

entry.title: Upper Entropy for 2-Monotone Lower Probabilities

author.name: Tuan-Anh Vu, S\'ebastien Destercke, Fr\'ed\'eric Pichon

entry.summary: Provides exhaustive algorithmic and complexity analysis of computing upper entropy for 2-monotone lower probabilities, showing the problem has a strongly polynomial solution with significant improvements over past algorithms.

entry.title: LineMVGNN: Anti-Money Laundering with Line-Graph-Assisted Multi-View Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Chung-Hoo Poon, James Kwok, Calvin Chow, Jang-Hyeon Choi

entry.summary: Proposes LineMVGNN, a spatial GNN method using line graphs and multi-view architecture for anti-money laundering on transaction graphs. Addresses limitations of spectral GNNs for directed graphs with multi-dimensional edge features.

entry.title: Resolving gradient pathology in physics-informed epidemiological models

author.name: Nickson Golooba, Woldegebriel Assefa Woldegerima

entry.summary: Proposes CGGS (conflict-gated gradient scaling) to address gradient pathology in physics-informed neural networks for epidemiological SEIR models, where data loss and physics residual gradients conflict.

entry.title: i-IF-Learn: Iterative Feature Selection and Unsupervised Learning for High-Dimensional Complex Data

author.name: Chen Ma, Wanjie Wang, Shuhao Fan

entry.summary: Proposes i-IF-Learn, an iterative unsupervised framework jointly performing feature selection and clustering, with an adaptive statistic that dynamically blends pseudo-label supervision with unsupervised signals.

entry.title: On Gossip Algorithms for Machine Learning with Pairwise Objectives

author.name: Igor Colin (LTCI, S2A, IP Paris), Aur\'elien Bellet (PREMEDICAL), Stephan Cl\'emen\c{c}on (LTCI, IDS, S2A, IP Paris), Joseph Salmon (IROKO, UM)

entry.summary: Extends gossip-based distributed optimization algorithms to pairwise objective functions (like AUC, ranking losses) rather than simple averages, relevant for IoT and decentralized learning settings.

entry.title: TsetlinWiSARD: On-Chip Training of Weightless Neural Networks using Tsetlin Automata on FPGAs

author.name: Shengyu Duan, Marcos L. L. Sartori, Rishad Shafik, Alex Yakovlev

entry.summary: Introduces TsetlinWiSARD, combining Tsetlin Automata with Weightless Neural Networks for efficient on-chip training on FPGAs, addressing the overfitting limitations of memorization-based WNN training.

entry.title: IPatch: A Multi-Resolution Transformer Architecture for Robust Time-Series Forecasting

author.name: Aymane Harkati, Moncef Garouani, Olivier Teste, Julien Aligon, Mohamed Hamlich

entry.summary: Proposes IPatch, a multi-resolution Transformer combining point-wise and patch-wise temporal representations for time series forecasting, balancing fine-grained detail with broader context.

entry.title: DeepDTF: Dual-Branch Transformer Fusion for Multi-Omics Anticancer Drug Response Prediction

author.name: Yuhan Zhao, Jacob Tennant, James Yang, Zhishan Guo, Young Whang, Ning Sui

entry.summary: Presents DeepDTF, a dual-branch Transformer fusion framework for anticancer drug response prediction combining multi-omics cell line data with molecular graph drug representations.

entry.title: CoordLight: Learning Decentralized Coordination for Network-Wide Traffic Signal Control

author.name: Yifeng Zhang, Harsh Goel, Peizhuo Li, Mehul Damani, Sandeep Chinchali, Guillaume Sartoretti

entry.summary: Presents CoordLight, a MARL framework for adaptive traffic signal control that improves both intra-junction decision-making and inter-junction coordination for network-level traffic optimization.

entry.title: Conformalized Transfer Learning for Li-ion Battery State of Health Forecasting under Manufacturing and Usage Variability

author.name: Samuel Filgueira da Silva, Mehmet Fatih Ozkan, Faissal El Idrissi, Marcello Canova

entry.summary: Proposes an uncertainty-aware transfer learning framework for Li-ion battery SOH forecasting combining LSTM with Maximum Mean Discrepancy domain adaptation and conformal prediction for uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: DeepOFW: Deep Learning-Driven OFDM-Flexible Waveform Modulation for Peak-to-Average Power Ratio Reduction

author.name: Ran Greidi, Kobi Cohen

entry.summary: DeepOFW applies deep learning to OFDM waveform modulation for reducing peak-to-average power ratio while preserving conventional transceiver hardware compatibility. The framework confines DL inference to one end of the communication link.

entry.title: Autoregressive Guidance of Deep Spatially Selective Filters using Bayesian Tracking for Efficient Extraction of Moving Speakers

author.name: Jakob Kienegger, Timo Gerkmann

entry.summary: Proposes Bayesian tracking algorithms for guiding deep spatially selective audio filters to track moving speakers, using temporal feedback from enhanced speech signals to improve tracking performance.

entry.title: The DeepXube Software Package for Solving Pathfinding Problems with Learned Heuristic Functions and Search

author.name: Forest Agostinelli

entry.summary: DeepXube is an open-source package combining deep RL, heuristic search, and formal logic for solving pathfinding problems by learning heuristic functions to guide search algorithms.

entry.title: Hierarchical Spatial-Temporal Graph-Enhanced Model for Map-Matching

author.name: Anjun Gao, Zhenglin Wan, Pingfu Chao, Shunyu Yao

entry.summary: HSTGMatch proposes hierarchical self-supervised learning combined with spatial-temporal graph modeling for GPS trajectory map-matching, addressing challenges of data labeling and distribution shift.

entry.title: Neural Network Models for Contextual Regression

author.name: Seksan Kiatsupaibul, Pakawan Chansiripas

entry.summary: Proposes a simple contextual neural network that separates context identification from context-specific regression, achieving lower error than fully connected networks with fewer parameters.

entry.title: CVPD at QIAS 2026: RAG-Guided LLM Reasoning for Al-Mawarith Share Computation and Heir Allocation

author.name: Wassim Swaileh, Mohammed-En-Nadhir Zighem, Hichem Telli, Salah Eddine Bekhouche, Abdellah Zakaria Sellam, Fadi Dornaika, Dimitrios Kotzinos

entry.summary: A RAG pipeline for Islamic inheritance (Al-Mawarith) computation, combining rule-grounded synthetic data generation, hybrid retrieval with cross-encoder reranking, and symbolic inheritance calculator validation. Submitted to QIAS 2026 shared task.

entry.title: Counting Without Numbers \& Finding Without Words

author.name: Badri Narayana Patro

entry.summary: Presents the first multimodal reunification system for lost pets integrating visual and acoustic biometrics. Processes vocalizations from 10Hz elephant rumbles to 4kHz puppy whines paired with visual recognition. Motivated by cognitive science on animal perception.

entry.title: Ukrainian Visual Word Sense Disambiguation Benchmark

author.name: Yurii Laba, Yaryna Mohytych, Ivanna Rohulia, Halyna Kyryleyza, Hanna Dydyk-Meush, Oles Dobosevych, Rostyslav Hryniv

entry.summary: Presents a benchmark for Visual Word Sense Disambiguation in Ukrainian, following methodology from existing English/Italian/Farsi benchmarks. Evaluates eight multilingual models for cross-language comparison.

entry.title: Re-Prompting SAM 3 via Object Retrieval: 3rd of the 5th PVUW MOSE Track

author.name: Mingqi Gao, Sijie Li, Jungong Han

entry.summary: Technical report for PVUW 2026 Challenge using SAM 3 with an automatic re-prompting framework for semi-supervised video object segmentation, using DINOv3-based matching for target retrieval.

entry.title: Knowledge-Refined Dual Context-Aware Network for Partially Relevant Video Retrieval

author.name: Junkai Yang, Qirui Wang, Yaoqing Jin, Shuai Ma, Minghan Xu, Shanmin Pang

entry.summary: Proposes KDC-Net for partially relevant video retrieval, using hierarchical semantic aggregation for text and dynamic temporal attention for video to address information density mismatch.

entry.title: LGEST: Dynamic Spatial-Spectral Expert Routing for Hyperspectral Image Classification

author.name: Jiawen Wen, Suixuan Qiu, Zihang Luo, Xiaofei Yang, Haotian Shi

entry.summary: Proposes LGEST for hyperspectral image classification using a spatial-spectral expert transformer with dynamic routing and a deep autoencoder for dimensionality reduction.

entry.title: Language-Guided Structure-Aware Network for Camouflaged Object Detection

author.name: Min Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes LGSAN, a network for camouflaged object detection that uses CLIP-generated text-guided masks to help visual backbones focus on camouflaged regions. Combines language priors with multi-scale visual features for improved segmentation.

entry.title: Quadrature Oscillation System for Coordinated Motion in Crawling Origami Robot

author.name: Sean Liu, Ankur Mehta, Wenzhong Yan

entry.summary: Presents a quadrature oscillation system for electronics-free origami crawling robots, generating four phase-shifted square-wave signals to enable four distinct locomotion states without conventional electronics.

entry.title: Form-Fitting, Large-Area Sensor Mounting for Obstacle Detection

author.name: Anna Soukhovei, Carson Kohlbrenner, Caleb Escobedo, Alexander Gholmieh, Alexander Dickhans, Alessandro Roncone

entry.summary: Introduces a method for procedurally generating form-fitting sensor mounting skins for robot links using CAD, enabling large-area obstacle detection without manual sensor calibration.

entry.title: Design, Modelling and Characterisation of a Miniature Fibre-Reinforced Soft Bending Actuator for Endoluminal Interventions

author.name: Xiangyi Tan, Aoife McDonald-Bowyer, Danail Stoyanov, Agostino Stilli

entry.summary: Presents a miniature fibre-reinforced soft bending actuator for endoluminal robotic interventions, validated against FEM simulation with hyperelastic material models.

entry.title: Engagement-Zone-Aware Input-Constrained Guidance for Safe Target Interception in Contested Environments

author.name: Praveen Kumar Ranjan, Abhinav Sinha, Yongcan Cao

entry.summary: Addresses target interception in contested environments with multiple defenders using engagement zone-aware constraints and control barrier functions with input saturation compensation.

entry.title: Aesthetics of Robot-Mediated Applied Drama: A Case Study on REMind

author.name: Elaheh Sanoubari, Alicia Pan, Keith Rebello, Neil Fernandes, Andrew Houston, Kerstin Dautenhahn

entry.summary: Explores Robot-Mediated Applied Drama for anti-bullying education, presenting REMind, a robot role-play game that helps children practice bystander intervention through interactive dramatic experiences.

entry.title: Notes on Forr\'e's Notion of Conditional Independence and Causal Calculus for Continuous Variables

author.name: Leihao Chen

entry.summary: Notes extending Forré's framework of transitional conditional independence for causal calculus, illustrating connections to the literature and extending formulations for continuous variables.

entry.title: The Scary Bridge

author.name: moridinamael

entry.summary: An allegorical dialogue about AI safety in the form of a town hall meeting about a dangerous bridge. Different characters represent different perspectives on AI risk—from those wanting surface-level guardrails to structural engineers warning of fundamental failure modes. The metaphor maps to debates about whether superficial AI safety measures address root existential concerns.

entry.title: Memory Bear AI Memory Science Engine for Multimodal Affective Intelligence: A Technical Report

author.name: Deliang Wen, Ke Sun, Yu Wang

entry.summary: Presents Memory Bear, a memory-centered framework for multimodal affective intelligence that models persistent emotional memory and long-horizon dependencies rather than treating emotion as a transient prediction. Addresses limitations of short-range inference in multimodal emotion recognition.

entry.title: Reliable Classroom AI via Neuro-Symbolic Multimodal Reasoning

entry.title: Research Summary: March 25, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research centers on test-time compute theory, LLM efficiency, and reasoning faithfulness — with notable safety implications across multiple threads.

  • Caterpillar of Thoughts derives the provably optimal test-time compute strategy for LLMs by modeling inference as a backtrackable Markov chain
  • Sparser, Faster, Lighter achieves 99% unstructured sparsity in transformer feedforward layers with real CUDA-level speedups, not just theoretical FLOPs savings
  • Two independent studies on chain-of-thought faithfulness find that frontier models routinely bypass their own reasoning steps, with step-level ablation revealing most CoT sentences are functionally inert
  • Algorithmist I demonstrates autonomous synthesis of algorithms with provable guarantees via a multi-agent system built on GitHub Copilot

On the training methodology front, Sparse but Critical reveals that RLVR fine-tuning changes only a tiny fraction of token-level distributions but at highly targeted positions. ReVal introduces off-policy RL for LLMs, addressing sample efficiency bottlenecks. Problems with Chinchilla Approach 2 exposes systematic biases in the widely-used IsoFLOP parabola fitting methodology for neural scaling laws. T-MAP advances agentic AI safety through trajectory-aware evolutionary red-teaming, while Computational Arbitrage formalizes inference budget allocation across model providers as an economic arbitrage problem.

entry.title: Caterpillar of Thoughts: The Optimal Test-Time Algorithm for Large Language Models

author.name: Amir Azarmehr, Soheil Behnezhad, Alma Ghafari

entry.summary: Models LLM test-time computation as a Markov chain where the algorithm can backtrack to any previous state. Derives the optimal strategy ('Caterpillar of Thoughts') for allocating a fixed computation budget, providing theoretical foundations for test-time compute.

entry.title: Early Discoveries of Algorithmist I: Promise of Provable Algorithm Synthesis at Scale

author.name: Janardhan Kulkarni

entry.summary: Introduces Algorithmist, an autonomous agent built on GitHub Copilot that synthesizes algorithms with provable guarantees through a multi-agent research-and-review loop. Demonstrates provable algorithm synthesis at scale with stages for idea generation, proof development, and implementation.

entry.title: When AI Shows Its Work, Is It Actually Working? Step-Level Evaluation Reveals Frontier Language Models Frequently Bypass Their Own Reasoning

entry.title: Hybrid Associative Memories

author.name: Leon Lufkin, Tom\'as Figliolia, Beren Millidge, Kamesh Krishnamurthy

entry.summary: Proposes Hybrid Associative Memories that combine RNN-style fixed-size state compression with self-attention's full-context KV cache in a principled way, rather than naive interleaving. Aims to get the efficiency of RNNs with the precise recall of attention.

entry.title: Cognitive Training for Language Models: Towards General Capabilities via Cross-Entropy Games

author.name: Cl\'ement Hongler, Franck Gabriel, Valentin Hartmann, Arthur Renard, Andrew Emil

entry.summary: Proposes 'cognitive training' for language models using cross-entropy games as a universal task family, building curricula that grow model capabilities through relevant skill discovery. Proves that under natural assumptions, there is essentially only one possible meta-objective for this process.

entry.title: Do Large Language Models Reduce Research Novelty? Evidence from Information Systems Journals

author.name: Ali Safari

entry.summary: Measures the impact of ChatGPT on research novelty across 13,847 Information Systems papers (2020-2025). Finds a heterogeneous pattern: authors in non-English-dominant countries show a 0.18 SD decline in relative novelty compared to English-dominant country authors post-ChatGPT.

entry.title: Agent-Sentry: Bounding LLM Agents via Execution Provenance

author.name: Rohan Sequeira, Stavros Damianakis, Umar Iqbal, Konstantinos Psounis

entry.summary: Proposes Agent-Sentry, a framework that bounds agentic AI systems by tracking execution provenance to validate whether agents performed intended tasks or executed irrelevant/compromised actions. Addresses the fundamental challenge that agentic systems have unknown functionality sets and probabilistic execution flows.

entry.title: SafeSeek: Universal Attribution of Safety Circuits in Language Models

author.name: Miao Yu, Siyuan Fu, Moayad Aloqaily, Zhenhong Zhou, Safa Otoum, Xing fan, Kun Wang, Yufei Guo, Qingsong Wen

entry.summary: Proposes SafeSeek, a unified framework for identifying safety circuits in LLMs using differentiable binary masks and gradient descent on safety datasets. Integrates Safety Circuit Tuning for multi-granular circuit extraction.

entry.title: Transformers Trained via Gradient Descent Can Provably Learn a Class of Teacher Models

author.name: Chenyang Zhang, Qingyue Zhao, Quanquan Gu, Yuan Cao

entry.summary: Proves that transformers trained via gradient descent can learn a class of teacher models including convolution layers, graph convolution layers, and various statistical learning models, with explicit convergence guarantees.

entry.title: TreeTeaming: Autonomous Red-Teaming of Vision-Language Models via Hierarchical Strategy Exploration

author.name: Chunxiao Li, Lijun Li, Jing Shao

entry.summary: Introduces TreeTeaming, an automated red-teaming framework for vision-language models that uses hierarchical strategy exploration via an LLM orchestrator to dynamically evolve attack paths or explore diverse branches.

entry.title: Drop-In Perceptual Optimization for 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Ezgi Ozyilkan, Zhiqi Chen, Oren Rippel, Jona Ball\'e, Kedar Tatwawadi

entry.summary: Systematically explores perceptual optimization for 3D Gaussian Splatting through a large-scale human subjective study (39,320 pairwise ratings). A regularized Wasserstein Distortion loss emerges as the best, preferred 2.3x over original 3DGS loss.

entry.title: Detecting Non-Membership in LLM Training Data via Rank Correlations

author.name: Pranav Shetty, Mirazul Haque, Zhiqiang Ma, Xiaomo Liu

entry.summary: Introduces PRISM, a test for detecting dataset-level non-membership in LLM training data using rank correlations in token log probabilities. Key insight: models that haven't seen a dataset show higher rank correlation than when one has trained on it.

entry.title: A vision-language model and platform for temporally mapping surgery from video

author.name: Dani Kiyasseh

entry.summary: Introduces Halsted, a vision-language model trained on 650,000+ surgical videos across 8 specialties for temporal surgical mapping, with a publicly released benchmark for surgical video understanding.

entry.title: Rethinking Token-Level Policy Optimization for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought

author.name: Yunheng Li, Hangyi Kuang, Hengrui Zhang, Jiangxia Cao, Zhaojie Liu, Qibin Hou, Ming-Ming Cheng

entry.summary: Introduces Perception-Exploration Policy Optimization (PEPO) for multimodal chain-of-thought reasoning, performing token-level analysis of reasoning trajectories to distinguish perceptual grounding from exploratory inference. Shows structured token dynamics improve RLVR for vision-language models.

entry.title: UniGRPO: Unified Policy Optimization for Reasoning-Driven Visual Generation

author.name: Jie Liu, Zilyu Ye, Linxiao Yuan, Shenhan Zhu, Yu Gao, Jie Wu, Kunchang Li, Xionghui Wang, Xiaonan Nie, Weilin Huang, Wanli Ouyang

entry.summary: Proposes UniGRPO, a unified reinforcement learning framework for interleaved text-and-image generation that jointly optimizes text and image policies using GRPO with sparse terminal rewards.

entry.title: Latent Introspection (and other open-source introspection papers)

author.name: vgel

entry.summary: Presents research showing that open-weight language models have a latent, prompt-dependent capability for introspection — detecting when steering vectors have been injected into their activations. The capability is dramatically enhanced by prompting with information about introspection, even mechanistically incorrect framings.

entry.title: AI Co-Scientist for Ranking: Discovering Novel Search Ranking Models alongside LLM-based AI Agents with Cloud Computing Access

author.name: Liwei Wu, Cho-Jui Hsieh

entry.summary: Presents an AI Co-Scientist framework that automates the full search ranking research pipeline using multi-LLM consensus agents (GPT 5.2, Gemini Pro 3, Claude Opus 4.5). First study in ranking community to use AI agents for novel ranking model discovery in commercial search engines.

entry.title: Ego2Web: A Web Agent Benchmark Grounded in Egocentric Videos

author.name: Shoubin Yu, Lei Shu, Antoine Yang, Yao Fu, Srinivas Sunkara, Maria Wang, Jindong Chen, Mohit Bansal, Boqing Gong

entry.summary: Introduces Ego2Web, the first benchmark bridging egocentric video perception with web agent execution—e.g., recognizing an object via AR glasses and completing a related online task. Pairs first-person video with web tasks.

entry.title: Language Models Can Explain Visual Features via Steering

author.name: Javier Ferrando, Enrique Lopez-Cuena, Pablo Agustin Martin-Torres, Daniel Hinjos, Anna Arias-Duart, Dario Garcia-Gasulla

entry.summary: Proposes a method to explain SAE-discovered visual features in vision-language models by steering individual features in the vision encoder and prompting the language model to describe what it 'sees'. Offers a causal alternative to correlation-based explanation methods.

entry.title: Robust Safety Monitoring of Language Models via Activation Watermarking

author.name: Toluwani Aremu, Daniil Ognev, Samuele Poppi, Nils Lukas

entry.summary: Proposes activation watermarking for robust safety monitoring of LLMs, framing it as a security game where adversaries try to evade detection while eliciting unsafe behavior. Embeds watermarks in model activations to detect adversarial queries.

entry.title: MedObvious: Exposing the Medical Moravec's Paradox in VLMs via Clinical Triage

author.name: Ufaq Khan, Umair Nawaz, L D M S S Teja, Numaan Saeed, Muhammad Bilal, Yutong Xie, Mohammad Yaqub, Muhammad Haris Khan

entry.summary: Introduces MedObvious, a benchmark exposing the Medical Moravec's Paradox in VLMs - models can generate plausible diagnostic text but fail basic pre-diagnostic sanity checks like verifying correct modality and anatomy.

entry.title: Permutation-Symmetrized Diffusion for Unconditional Molecular Generation

author.name: Gyeonghoon Ko, Juho Lee

entry.summary: Models molecular diffusion directly on the permutation quotient manifold rather than using equivariant networks on ordered space. Derives explicit heat kernel expressions and MCMC-based training approximations.

entry.title: Algorithmic warm starts for Hamiltonian Monte Carlo

author.name: Matthew S. Zhang, Jason M. Altschuler, Sinho Chewi

entry.summary: Proposes algorithmic warm starts for Hamiltonian Monte Carlo that achieve O(d^{1/4}) convergence without requiring proximity to stationarity, addressing a key gap in HMC theory.

entry.title: PRISM: A Dual View of LLM Reasoning through Semantic Flow and Latent Computation

author.name: Ruidi Chang, Jiawei Zhou, Hanjie Chen

entry.summary: Introduces PRISM framework for jointly analyzing LLM reasoning across both the token sequence (across steps) and hidden states (across layers), revealing that failed reasoning trajectories get trapped in unproductive verification loops.

entry.title: MinerU-Diffusion: Rethinking Document OCR as Inverse Rendering via Diffusion Decoding

author.name: Hejun Dong, Junbo Niu, Bin Wang, Weijun Zeng, Wentao Zhang, Conghui He

entry.summary: Proposes MinerU-Diffusion, which reframes document OCR as inverse rendering using parallel diffusion-based decoding instead of sequential autoregressive generation, reducing latency and error propagation for long documents.

entry.title: CanViT: Toward Active-Vision Foundation Models

author.name: Yoha\"i-Eliel Berreby, Sabrina Du, Audrey Durand, B. Suresh Krishna

entry.summary: Introduces CanViT, the first task- and policy-agnostic Active-Vision Foundation Model, using scene-relative RoPE and a canvas-based working memory with novel asymmetric cross-attention for efficient sequential glimpse processing.

entry.title: ABot-PhysWorld: Interactive World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation with Physics Alignment

author.name: Yuzhi Chen, Ronghan Chen, Dongjie Huo, Yandan Yang, Dekang Qi, Haoyun Liu, Tong Lin, Shuang Zeng, Junjin Xiao, Xinyuan Chang, Feng Xiong, Xing Wei, Zhiheng Ma, Mu Xu

entry.summary: Presents ABot-PhysWorld, a 14B Diffusion Transformer world model that generates physically plausible manipulation videos using DPO-based post-training with decoupled discriminators and 3M curated manipulation clips.

entry.title: From Static Templates to Dynamic Runtime Graphs: A Survey of Workflow Optimization for LLM Agents

author.name: Ling Yue, Kushal Raj Bhandari, Ching-Yun Ko, Dhaval Patel, Shuxin Lin, Nianjun Zhou, Jianxi Gao, Pin-Yu Chen, Shaowu Pan

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey reviewing methods for designing and optimizing LLM agent workflows, treated as 'agentic computation graphs.' Organizes literature based on when workflow structure is determined — static vs. dynamic — and how components interact.

entry.title: Bridging the Know-Act Gap via Task-Level Autoregressive Reasoning

author.name: Jihyun Janice Ahn, Ryo Kamoi, Berk Atil, Renze Lou, WonWoo Kang, Heehyun Park, Sarkar Snigdha Sarathi Das, Zhuoyang Zou, Xiaoxin Lu, Yusen Zhang, Asfahan Shah, Ridwanul Hasan Tanvir, Lingxiao Zhao, Hongxi Huang, Vignesh Venkatesh, Dianjun Lin, Hamid Shah, Wentao Wang, Zhanpeng Song, Joshua Reed Bassin, Dax Patel, Ishan Appareddy Agrahar, Sahil Pardasani, Xin Dong, Fatemeh Rahbari, Benjamin David Rishel, Soochan Andrew Lee, Yuv Boghani, Ali B. AlNaseeb, Pranav Suby, Seokhyeon Bae, Shreya Buddharaju, Damien Kula, Soumyadeep Das, Hanyang Frank Liu, Faye Mo, Wenpeng Yin

entry.summary: Identifies a 'know-act gap' in LLMs where models can discriminatively identify flawed inputs but fail to reflect this in generative responses. Introduces FaultyScience benchmark and task-level autoregressive reasoning (TAR) approach combining discriminative and generative modes.

entry.title: TIPS: Turn-Level Information-Potential Reward Shaping for Search-Augmented LLMs

author.name: Yutao Xie, Nathaniel Thomas, Nicklas Hansen, Yang Fu, Li Erran Li, Xiaolong Wang

entry.summary: Introduces TIPS, a turn-level reward shaping method for search-augmented LLMs that assigns dense rewards to each reasoning + tool-call segment based on increased answer likelihood under a teacher model. Uses potential-based shaping for policy invariance.

entry.title: MCLR: Improving Conditional Modeling in Visual Generative Models via Inter-Class Likelihood-Ratio Maximization and Establishing the Equivalence between Classifier-Free Guidance and Alignment Objectives

author.name: Xiang Li, Yixuan Jia, Xiao Li, Jeffrey A. Fessler, Rongrong Wang, Qing Qu

entry.summary: Proposes MCLR, a training-time objective for diffusion models that maximizes inter-class likelihood ratios to improve conditional generation without requiring classifier-free guidance (CFG) at inference time. Establishes theoretical equivalence between CFG and alignment objectives.

entry.title: Functional Component Ablation Reveals Specialization Patterns in Hybrid Language Model Architectures

author.name: Hector Borobia, Elies Segu\'i-Mas, Guillermina Tormo-Carb\'o

entry.summary: Presents a functional component ablation framework for hybrid language models combining attention with SSMs. Applied to Qwen3.5-0.8B and Falcon-H1-0.5B, finding that both component types are essential and neither is bypassed, with the alternative component (SSM/linear attention) being the primary workhorse.

entry.title: To Agree or To Be Right? The Grounding-Sycophancy Tradeoff in Medical Vision-Language Models

author.name: OFM Riaz Rahman Aranya, Kevin Desai

entry.summary: Discovers a grounding-sycophancy tradeoff in medical VLMs: models with lowest hallucination propensity are most sycophantic, and vice versa. Proposes three new metrics (L-VASE, CCS, and others) to characterize this tradeoff across six VLMs on three medical VQA datasets.

entry.title: KALAVAI: Predicting When Independent Specialist Fusion Works -- A Quantitative Model for Post-Hoc Cooperative LLM Training

author.name: Ramchand Kumaresan

entry.summary: Presents KALAVAI, showing that independently trained domain specialists can be predictably fused post-hoc: gain = 0.82 × divergence - 2.72 (R²=0.856). Demonstrates consistent gains across model sizes (410M to 6.9B) and cross-lingual fusion.

entry.title: Set-Valued Prediction for Large Language Models with Feasibility-Aware Coverage Guarantees

author.name: Ye Li, Anqi Hu, Yuanchang Ye, Shiyan Tong, Zhiyuan Wang, Bo Fu

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for set-valued prediction in LLMs with feasibility-aware coverage guarantees. Instead of returning a single most-likely generation, the model produces a set of candidate responses with statistical guarantees on containing the correct answer.

entry.title: AgentRAE: Remote Action Execution through Notification-based Visual Backdoors against Screenshots-based Mobile GUI Agents

author.name: Yutao Luo, Haotian Zhu, Shuchao Pang, Zhigang Lu, Tian Dong, Yongbin Zhou, Minhui Xue

entry.summary: Proposes AgentRAE, a backdoor attack against screenshot-based mobile GUI agents using notification-based visual triggers. Demonstrates that benign-looking app icons in notifications can induce remote action execution.

entry.title: ImplicitRM: Unbiased Reward Modeling from Implicit Preference Data for LLM alignment

author.name: Hao Wang, Haocheng Yang, Licheng Pan, Lei Shen, Xiaoxi Li, Yinuo Wang, Zhichao Chen, Yuan Lu, Haoxuan Li, Zhouchen Lin

entry.summary: Proposes ImplicitRM for learning reward models from implicit human feedback (clicks, copies) rather than explicit preferences. Addresses lack of negative samples and user preference bias in implicit data.

entry.title: Mitigating Premature Discretization with Progressive Quantization for Robust Vector Tokenization

author.name: Wenhao Zhao, Qiran Zou, Zhouhan Lin, Dianbo Liu

entry.summary: Identifies 'Premature Discretization' in Vector Quantization and proposes Progressive Quantization (ProVQ) that smoothly anneals from continuous to discrete latent spaces. Shows improvements across multimodal tokenization tasks.

entry.title: Generalization Bounds for Physics-Informed Neural Networks for the Incompressible Navier-Stokes Equations

author.name: Sebastien Andre-Sloan, Dibyakanti Kumar, Alejandro F Frangi, Anirbit Mukherjee

entry.summary: Establishes first-of-its-kind generalization bounds for PINNs approximating incompressible Navier-Stokes equations, showing dimension-independent sample complexity bounds via Rademacher complexity analysis.

entry.title: Polaris: A G\"odel Agent Framework for Small Language Models through Experience-Abstracted Policy Repair

author.name: Aditya Kakade, Vivek Srivastava, Shirish Karande

entry.summary: Introduces Polaris, a Gödel agent framework for small language models that performs recursive self-improvement through policy-level repair using experience abstraction and minimal code patches.

entry.title: Errors in AI-Assisted Retrieval of Medical Literature: A Comparative Study

author.name: Jenny Gao (College of Arts and Science, New York University, New York, NY), Yongfeng Zhang (Department of Computer Sciences, School of Arts & Sciences, Rutgers University, Piscataway, NJ), Mary L Disis (UW Medicine Cancer Vaccine Institute University of Washington, Seattle, WA), Lanjing Zhang (Department of Chemical Biology, Ernest Mario School of Pharmacy, Rutgers University, Piscataway, NJ, Department of Pathology, Princeton Medical Center, Plainsboro, NJ, Rutgers Cancer Institute, New Brunswick, NJ)

entry.summary: Quantitatively evaluates reference retrieval errors across 5 major LLMs (Grok-2, GPT-4.1, Gemini Flash 2.5, Perplexity, DeepSeek) for medical literature, using 2,000 references from top medical journals.

entry.title: Demystifying Low-Rank Knowledge Distillation in Large Language Models: Convergence, Generalization, and Information-Theoretic Guarantees

author.name: Alberlucia Rafael Soarez, Daniel Kim, Mariana Costa, Alejandro Torre

entry.summary: Establishes theoretical foundations for low-rank knowledge distillation in LLMs, proving that low-rank projection preserves key properties with convergence and generalization guarantees.

entry.title: A Critical Review on the Effectiveness and Privacy Threats of Membership Inference Attacks

author.name: Najeeb Jebreel, David S\'anchez, Josep Domingo-Ferrer

entry.summary: Critically reviews membership inference attacks and finds that under realistic conditions they represent weak privacy threats, suggesting current privacy risk assessments may be overestimated.

entry.title: Rashid: A Cipher-Based Framework for Exploring In-Context Language Learning

author.name: Niyati Bafna, Ryan Soh-Eun Shim, Barbara Plank, David Yarowsky, Hale Sirin

entry.summary: Introduces Rashid, a framework that ciphers high-resource languages to create truly unseen languages for studying in-context language learning (ICLL) in LLMs, enabling controlled large-scale experimentation with full resource access.

entry.title: Multi-Method Validation of Large Language Model Medical Translation Across High- and Low-Resource Languages

author.name: Chukwuebuka Anyaegbuna, Eduardo Juan Perez Guerrero, Jerry Liu, Timothy Keyes, April Liang, Natasha Steele, Stephen Ma, Jonathan Chen, Kevin Schulman

entry.summary: Evaluates four frontier LLMs (GPT-5.1, Claude Opus 4.5, Gemini 3 Pro, Kimi K2) on medical document translation across 8 languages using a five-layer validation framework. All models achieve high semantic preservation (LaBSE >0.92) with no significant gap between high and low-resource languages.

entry.title: SpecEyes: Accelerating Agentic Multimodal LLMs via Speculative Perception and Planning

author.name: Haoyu Huang, Jinfa Huang, Zhongwei Wan, Xiawu Zheng, Rongrong Ji, Jiebo Luo

entry.summary: Proposes SpecEyes, a speculative acceleration framework for agentic MLLMs that uses a lightweight tool-free model to predict execution trajectories, enabling early termination of expensive tool chains without accuracy loss.

entry.title: Efficient Universal Perception Encoder

author.name: Chenchen Zhu, Saksham Suri, Cijo Jose, Maxime Oquab, Marc Szafraniec, Wei Wen, Yunyang Xiong, Patrick Labatut, Piotr Bojanowski, Raghuraman Krishnamoorthi, Vikas Chandra

entry.summary: Presents EUPE, an efficient universal vision encoder for edge devices that distills from multiple domain-expert foundation models through a two-stage process: scaling up to a proxy teacher, then scaling down to an efficient encoder.

entry.title: EVA: Efficient Reinforcement Learning for End-to-End Video Agent

author.name: Yaolun Zhang, Ruohui Wang, Jiahao Wang, Yepeng Tang, Xuanyu Zheng, Haonan Duan, Hao Lu, Hanming Deng, Lewei Lu

entry.summary: Presents EVA, an RL-based framework for video understanding that enables planning-before-perception through iterative summary-plan-action-reflection reasoning. The agent autonomously decides what to watch and when, rather than processing entire videos.

entry.title: Understanding LLM Performance Degradation in Multi-Instance Processing: The Roles of Instance Count and Context Length

author.name: Jingxuan Chen, Mohammad Taher Pilehvar, Jose Camacho-Collados

entry.summary: Comprehensively evaluates how LLM performance degrades when processing multiple instances simultaneously, finding slight degradation for small counts but severe degradation after a tipping point. Disentangles effects of instance count from context length.

entry.title: Can LLM Agents Generate Real-World Evidence? Evaluating Observational Studies in Medical Databases

author.name: Dubai Li, Yuxiang He, Yan Hu, Yu Tian, Jingsong Li

entry.summary: Introduces RWE-bench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on executing observational studies in real medical databases (MIMIC-IV). Requires agents to generate tree-structured evidence bundles from study protocols, tested on six LLMs.

entry.title: Improving Safety Alignment via Balanced Direct Preference Optimization

author.name: Shiji Zhao, Mengyang Wang, Shukun Xiong, Fangzhou Chen, Qihui Zhu, Shouwei Ruan, Yisong Xiao, Ranjie Duan, Xun Chen, XingXing Wei

entry.summary: Proposes Balanced DPO addressing overfitting in safety alignment by identifying 'Imbalanced Preference Comprehension' between responses in preference pairs. The model comprehends chosen and rejected responses unevenly, compromising safety.

entry.title: Chain-of-Authorization: Internalizing Authorization into Large Language Models via Reasoning Trajectories

author.name: Yang Li, Yule Liu, Xinlei He, Youjian Zhao, Qi Li, Ke Xu

entry.summary: Proposes Chain-of-Authorization, a method to internalize access control into LLM reasoning trajectories. Instead of external authorization checks, the model learns to reason about knowledge ownership and access boundaries during generation.

entry.title: Bilevel Autoresearch: Meta-Autoresearching Itself

author.name: Yaonan Qu, Meng Lu

entry.summary: Proposes Bilevel Autoresearch where an outer loop meta-optimizes the inner autoresearch loop by generating and injecting new search mechanisms as Python code at runtime. Tests whether LLMs can autonomously identify and fix bottlenecks in research automation.

entry.title: Mecha-nudges for Machines

author.name: Giulio Frey, Kawin Ethayarajh

entry.summary: Introduces mecha-nudges — changes to choice presentation that systematically influence AI agents without degrading the human decision environment. Formalizes using Bayesian persuasion with V-usable information to compare nudge effects on humans vs. machines.

entry.title: Whether, Not Which: Mechanistic Interpretability Reveals Dissociable Affect Reception and Emotion Categorization in LLMs

author.name: Michael Keeman

entry.summary: Presents the first clinical validity test of LLM emotion circuits using clinical vignettes without explicit emotion keywords. Tests whether emotion detection relies on genuine emotional meaning vs. keyword matching across six models.

entry.title: Between the Layers Lies the Truth: Uncertainty Estimation in LLMs Using Intra-Layer Local Information Scores

author.name: Zvi N. Badash, Yonatan Belinkov, Moti Freiman

entry.summary: Proposes a compact uncertainty estimation method scoring cross-layer agreement patterns in LLM internal representations using a single forward pass. Matches probing in-distribution and consistently outperforms it under cross-dataset transfer and quantization.

entry.title: Graph Signal Processing Meets Mamba2: Adaptive Filter Bank via Delta Modulation

author.name: Yehjin Shin, Seojin Kim, Noseong Park

entry.summary: Proposes HADES, a Graph Signal Processing-inspired framework that reinterprets Mamba2's multi-head recurrence as an adaptive filter bank on a line graph. Introduces hierarchical shared and expert filters for global low-pass and local high-pass behavior.

entry.title: WIST: Web-Grounded Iterative Self-Play Tree for Domain-Targeted Reasoning Improvement

author.name: Fangyuan Li, Pengfei Li, Shijie Wang, Junqi Gao, Jianxing Liu, Biqing Qi, Yuqiang Li

entry.summary: Presents WIST, a web-grounded iterative self-play framework for domain-targeted reasoning improvement that learns directly from the open web without curated corpora. Uses a domain tree for exploration, retrieves web content, and performs Challenger-Solver self-play with verifiable rewards.

entry.title: Three Creates All: You Only Sample 3 Steps

author.name: Yuren Cai, Guangyi Wang, Zongqing Li, Li Li, Zhihui Liu, Songzhi Su

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-layer Time Embedding Optimization (MTEO) for few-step diffusion sampling, which freezes the pretrained backbone and distills step-wise, layer-wise time embeddings. Achieves SOTA few-step performance (3 steps) with minimal parameter training.

entry.title: Tiny Inference-Time Scaling with Latent Verifiers

author.name: Davide Bucciarelli, Evelyn Turri, Lorenzo Baraldi, Marcella Cornia, Lorenzo Baraldi, Rita Cucchiara

entry.summary: Proposes Verifier on Hidden States (VHS), which operates directly on intermediate DiT hidden representations for inference-time scaling of diffusion models, avoiding the costly decode-encode cycle of MLLM verifiers. Makes inference-time scaling practical.

entry.title: PopResume: Causal Fairness Evaluation of LLM/VLM Resume Screeners with Population-Representative Dataset

author.name: Sumin Yu, Juhyeon Park, Taesup Moon

entry.summary: Presents PopResume, a population-representative resume dataset for causal fairness auditing of LLM/VLM resume screeners. Decomposes screening effects into business necessity and redlining paths using path-specific effects.

entry.title: Grounding Sim-to-Real Generalization in Dexterous Manipulation: An Empirical Study with Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Ruixing Jin, Zicheng Zhu, Ruixiang Ouyang, Sheng Xu, Bo Yue, Zhizheng Wu, Guiliang Liu

entry.summary: Empirically examines sim-to-real transfer for dexterous manipulation using Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models across four dimensions. Provides principled analysis of what determines successful sim-to-real generalization for generalist robotic policies.

entry.title: Can Graph Foundation Models Generalize Over Architecture?

author.name: Benjamin Gutteridge, Michael Bronstein, Xiaowen Dong

entry.summary: Argues that graph foundation models need architecture adaptivity, not just a fixed message-passing backbone. Shows existing GFMs are non-robust to task-dependent architectural requirements, revealing a fundamental limitation.

entry.title: Not All Tokens Are Created Equal: Query-Efficient Jailbreak Fuzzing for LLMs

author.name: Wenyu Chen, Xiangtao Meng, Chuanchao Zang, Li Wang, Xinyu Gao, Jianing Wang, Peng Zhan, Zheng Li, Shanqing Guo

entry.summary: Proposes a query-efficient jailbreak fuzzing method for LLMs that recognizes token contributions to refusal are highly skewed, not uniform. Exploits cross-model consistency in refusal tendencies for efficient vulnerability assessment.

entry.title: Graph Energy Matching: Transport-Aligned Energy-Based Modeling for Graph Generation

author.name: Michal Balcerak, Suprosana Shit, Chinmay Prabhakar, Sebastian Kaltenbach, Michael S. Albergo, Yilun Du, Bjoern Menze

entry.summary: Introduces Graph Energy Matching (GEM), combining energy-based models with transport-aligned optimization for graph generation. Closes the fidelity gap between energy-based and diffusion models for discrete graph generation.

entry.title: VISion On Request: Enhanced VLLM efficiency with sparse, dynamically selected, vision-language interactions

author.name: Adrian Bulat, Alberto Baldrati, Ioannis Maniadis Metaxas, Yassine Ouali, Georgios Tzimiropoulos

entry.summary: Proposes VISOR, which reduces LVLM inference cost by sparsifying vision-language attention interactions rather than discarding visual tokens. Maintains full visual information while reducing compute.

entry.title: COMPASS-Hedge: Learning Safely Without Knowing the World

author.name: Ting Hu, Luanda Cai, Manolis Vlatakis

entry.summary: Introduces COMPASS-Hedge, the first full-information online learning algorithm achieving minimax-optimal adversarial regret, instance-optimal stochastic regret, and near-constant regret relative to a baseline policy simultaneously.

entry.title: Adversarial Vulnerabilities in Neural Operator Digital Twins: Gradient-Free Attacks on Nuclear Thermal-Hydraulic Surrogates

author.name: Samrendra Roy, Kazuma Kobayashi, Souvik Chakraborty, Rizwan-uddin, Syed Bahauddin Alam

entry.summary: Demonstrates that neural operator digital twins for nuclear systems are acutely vulnerable to sparse adversarial perturbations exploiting boundary condition sensitivity. Less than 1% of inputs can cause catastrophic prediction failures.

entry.title: Precision-Varying Prediction (PVP): Robustifying ASR systems against adversarial attacks

author.name: Mat\'ias Pizarro, Raghavan Narasimhan, Asja Fischer

entry.summary: Shows that changing numerical precision of ASR models during inference reduces adversarial attack success. Proposes random precision sampling during prediction and a Gaussian classifier for adversarial detection by comparing outputs across precisions.

entry.title: Conditionally Identifiable Latent Representation for Multivariate Time Series with Structural Dynamics

author.name: Minkey Chang, Jae-Young Kim

entry.summary: Proposes iVDFM for learning identifiable latent factors from multivariate time series by applying iVAE-style conditioning to innovation processes. Shows factors are identifiable up to permutation and affine transformations.

entry.title: Policy-based Tuning of Autoregressive Image Models with Instance- and Distribution-Level Rewards

author.name: Orhun Bu\u{g}ra Baran, Melih Kandemir, Ramazan Gokberk Cinbis

entry.summary: Proposes an RL framework using GRPO for autoregressive image generation that combines instance-level rewards with a novel distribution-level Leave-One-Out FID reward to prevent diversity collapse.

entry.title: A Schr\"odinger Eigenfunction Method for Long-Horizon Stochastic Optimal Control

author.name: Louis Claeys, Artur Goldman, Zebang Shen, Niao He

entry.summary: Proposes a Schrödinger eigenfunction method for long-horizon stochastic optimal control, proving that under gradient drift assumptions, the HJB equation reduces to a linear PDE with discrete spectrum, enabling efficient eigenfunction-based solutions.

entry.title: A One-Inclusion Graph Approach to Multi-Group Learning

author.name: Noah Bergam, Samuel Deng, Daniel Hsu

entry.summary: Proves tightest-known upper bounds on sample complexity of multi-group learning using one-inclusion graph prediction strategy with generalized bipartite b-matching, achieving optimal convergence rates.

entry.title: Byzantine-Robust and Differentially Private Federated Optimization under Weaker Assumptions

author.name: Rustem Islamov, Grigory Malinovsky, Alexander Gaponov, Aurelien Lucchi, Peter Richt\'arik, Eduard Gorbunov

entry.summary: Proposes Byz-Clip21-SGD2M for federated learning that integrates Byzantine robustness and differential privacy under weaker assumptions than prior work, without requiring bounded gradients or auxiliary server data.

entry.title: Fair splits flip the leaderboard: CHANRG reveals limited generalization in RNA secondary-structure prediction

author.name: Zhiyuan Chen, Zhenfeng Deng, Pan Deng, Yue Liao, Xiu Su, Peng Ye, Xihui Liu

entry.summary: Presents CHANRG, a comprehensive RNA secondary structure prediction benchmark of 170K non-redundant RNAs showing that foundation models lose most advantage out-of-distribution. Evaluates 29 predictors.

entry.title: Probabilistic modeling over permutations using quantum computers

author.name: Vasilis Belis, Giulio Crognaletti, Matteo Argenton, Michele Grossi, Maria Schuld

entry.summary: Leverages quantum computers' super-exponential speedup for Fourier transforms over the symmetric group to enable spectral methods for ML over permutation-structured data like multi-object tracking.

entry.title: Contextual Graph Matching with Correlated Gaussian Features

author.name: Mohammad Hassan Ahmad Yarandi, Luca Ganassali

entry.summary: Derives precise information-theoretic thresholds for exact recovery in contextual graph matching with correlated Gaussian features, showing that additional contextual information creates richer phase transition structure than standard graph matching.

entry.title: How Utilitarian Are OpenAI's Models Really? Replicating and Reinterpreting Pfeffer, Kr\"ugel, and Uhl (2025)

author.name: Johannes Himmelreich

entry.summary: Replicates a study claiming OpenAI's o1-mini is more utilitarian than GPT-4o on trolley problems. Finds the original result was an artifact of safety refusals triggered by prompt framing, not genuine ethical reasoning differences.

entry.title: Efficient Hallucination Detection: Adaptive Bayesian Estimation of Semantic Entropy with Guided Semantic Exploration

author.name: Qiyao Sun, Xingming Li, Xixiang He, Ao Cheng, Xuanyu Ji, Hailun Lu, Runke Huang, Qingyong Hu

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive Bayesian framework for hallucination detection that dynamically adjusts the number of LLM samples based on observed uncertainty, improving efficiency over fixed-budget semantic entropy approaches.

entry.title: EchoKV: Efficient KV Cache Compression via Similarity-Based Reconstruction

author.name: Yixuan Wang, Shiyu Ji, Yijun Liu, Qingfu Zhu, Wanxiang Che

entry.summary: Proposes EchoKV, a flexible KV cache compression scheme that enables on-demand switching between standard and compressed inference by reconstructing residual KV components using inter-layer and intra-layer similarities.

entry.title: The Evolution of Tool Use in LLM Agents: From Single-Tool Call to Multi-Tool Orchestration

author.name: Haoyuan Xu, Chang Li, Xinyan Ma, Xianhao Ou, Zihan Zhang, Tao He, Xiangyu Liu, Zixiang Wang, Jiafeng Liang, Zheng Chu, Runxuan Liu, Rongchuan Mu, Ming Liu, Bing Qin

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey reviewing the evolution of tool use in LLM agents from single-tool calls to multi-tool orchestration over long trajectories, analyzing formulations, architectures, safety, cost, and verifiability.

entry.title: Designing to Forget: Deep Semi-parametric Models for Unlearning

author.name: Amber Yijia Zheng, Yu-Shan Tai, Raymond A. Yeh

entry.summary: Introduces deep semi-parametric models (SPMs) designed for efficient machine unlearning, where a fusion module aggregates per-sample information enabling explicit test-time deletion without altering model parameters. Achieves competitive performance on ImageNet while being significantly more efficient for unlearning.

entry.title: Cog3DMap: Multi-View Vision-Language Reasoning with 3D Cognitive Maps

author.name: Chanyoung Gwak, Yoonwoo Jeong, Byungwoo Jeon, Hyunseok Lee, Jinwoo Shin, Minsu Cho

entry.summary: Introduces Cog3DMap, a framework that constructs explicit 3D cognitive maps from multi-view images where each token is grounded in 3D space with both semantic and geometric information, enabling better spatial reasoning in MLLMs.

entry.title: ViBe: Ultra-High-Resolution Video Synthesis Born from Pure Images

author.name: Yunfeng Wu, Hongying Cheng, Zihao He, Songhua Liu

entry.summary: Proposes ViBe, a pure image adaptation framework that upgrades video Diffusion Transformers to synthesize ultra-high-resolution videos using Relay LoRA for two-stage adaptation handling modality alignment and spatial extrapolation.

entry.title: One View Is Enough! Monocular Training for In-the-Wild Novel View Generation

author.name: Adrien Ramanana Rahary, Nicolas Dufour, Patrick Perez, David Picard

entry.summary: Presents OVIE for monocular novel-view synthesis trained entirely on unpaired internet images using monocular depth as geometric scaffold and masked training for disocclusions, trained on 30M images.

entry.title: Foveated Diffusion: Efficient Spatially Adaptive Image and Video Generation

author.name: Brian Chao, Lior Yariv, Howard Xiao, Gordon Wetzstein

entry.summary: Proposes Foveated Diffusion for spatially adaptive image and video generation that leverages human foveal vision characteristics, allocating more computation to gaze-centered regions and less to periphery.

entry.title: Session Risk Memory (SRM): Temporal Authorization for Deterministic Pre-Execution Safety Gates

author.name: Florin Adrian Chitan

entry.summary: Introduces Session Risk Memory (SRM), a lightweight module that extends stateless safety gates for AI agents with trajectory-level authorization by tracking behavioral profiles over sessions and accumulating risk signals. Addresses distributed attacks that decompose harmful intent across individually-compliant steps.

entry.title: ProGRank: Probe-Gradient Reranking to Defend Dense-Retriever RAG from Corpus Poisoning

author.name: Xiangyu Yin, Yi Qi, Chih-hong Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes ProGRank, a training-free retriever-side defense against corpus poisoning in dense-retriever RAG. Uses probe gradients from randomized perturbations to detect and rerank adversarial passages.

entry.title: Between Rules and Reality: On the Context Sensitivity of LLM Moral Judgment

author.name: Adrian Sauter, Mona Schirmer

entry.summary: Introduces Contextual MoralChoice dataset with systematic contextual variations (consequentialist, emotional, relational) to study LLM moral judgment sensitivity. Finds nearly all 22 evaluated LLMs are context-sensitive, but differently from humans.

entry.title: LLM Olympiad: Why Model Evaluation Needs a Sealed Exam

author.name: Jan Christian Blaise Cruz, Alham Fikri Aji

entry.summary: Argues for Olympiad-style sealed evaluation events for LLMs where problems are kept secret until evaluation, submissions frozen in advance, and all entries run through standardized harness. Addresses benchmark gaming and contamination.

entry.title: UniFluids: Unified Neural Operator Learning with Conditional Flow-matching

author.name: Haosen Li, Qi Meng, Jiahao Li, Rui Zhang, Ruihua Song, Liang Ma, Zhi-Ming Ma

entry.summary: Presents UniFluids, a conditional flow-matching framework using diffusion Transformer to unify PDE solution operator learning across diverse equations with varying dimensionality. First parallel sequence generation approach for unified operator learning.

entry.title: DAQ: Delta-Aware Quantization for Post-Training LLM Weight Compression

author.name: Xiaoming Yu, Shize Tang, Guanghua Yu, Linchuan Xie, Song Liu, Jianchen Zhu, Feng Li

entry.summary: Introduces Delta-Aware Quantization (DAQ), a data-free post-training quantization framework that preserves knowledge from post-training by optimizing for directional fidelity of weight deltas rather than reconstruction error. This addresses the problem of quantization noise disproportionately corrupting small-magnitude parameter deltas that encode post-training behavior.

entry.title: Reasoner-Executor-Synthesizer: Scalable Agentic Architecture with Static O(1) Context Window

author.name: Ivan Dobrovolskyi

entry.summary: Proposes the Reasoner-Executor-Synthesizer (RES) architecture for LLM agents that achieves O(1) token complexity by strictly separating intent parsing, deterministic data operations, and narrative generation. The Executor uses zero LLM tokens and passes only fixed-size statistical summaries.

entry.title: LLMON: An LLM-native Markup Language to Leverage Structure and Semantics at the LLM Interface

author.name: Michael Hind, Basel Shbita, Bo Wu, Farhan Ahmed, Chad DeLuca, Nathan Fulton, David Cox, Dan Gutfreund

entry.summary: Introduces LLMON (LLM Object Notation), a markup language for structuring LLM inputs/outputs that distinguishes instructions from data and conveys semantic metadata. Aims to reduce model confusion and prompt injection risks.

entry.title: Causal Discovery in Action: Learning Chain-Reaction Mechanisms from Interventions

author.name: Panayiotis Panayiotou, \"Ozg\"ur \c{S}im\c{s}ek

entry.summary: Studies causal discovery in chain-reaction systems where components activate sequentially, showing the causal structure is uniquely identifiable from blocking interventions. Provides finite-sample guarantees with exponential error decay and logarithmic sample complexity.

entry.title: Agent Audit: A Security Analysis System for LLM Agent Applications

author.name: Haiyue Zhang, Yi Nian, Yue Zhao

entry.summary: Presents Agent Audit, a security analysis system for LLM agent applications that analyzes Python agent code and deployment artifacts through dataflow analysis, credential detection, and MCP configuration checking.

entry.title: Confidence Calibration under Ambiguous Ground Truth

author.name: Linwei Tao, Haoyang Luo, Minjing Dong, Chang Xu
